subject: Re: Kickoff: pre-training vs specialized architectures study
body:
Confirming the July plan after yesterday's sync.

Farah takes over sweep execution today at her planned 60% allocation for the month — she's built the config matrix (5 seeds x 8 configs x 4 splits = 160 runs) with auto-retry on Titan preemptions, and results land in a live dashboard so Gustavo can watch the crossover question settle in real time.

Decision: we are NOT extending the sweep to the two extra model sizes Linnea proposed. It would push past Jul 13 and the data-budget crossover is the decision-relevant question, not absolute SOTA.

Linnea and Halima roll off this week as planned. Write-up review Jul 9, recommendation to Lucia Jul 10.

Alina
